narr: An upper low, surface tropical wave, and a very moist atmosphere combined to produce rain in the Central Savannah River Area during the morning, which resulted in flooding of roads in Augusta.
ev: Laney Walker Blvd Ext at E Boundary St, and E Boundary St and Sibley St, were closed due to flooding. Time estimated.
lsr: Augusta/Richmond dispatch reported Laney Walker Blvd Ext at E Boundary St closed due to flooding. Road closures also reported along the southend of E Boundary St and Sibley St.
